title: Voiding an Election under the Keyturn Guest Protection Plan
content:
An election under the Keyturn Guest Protection Plan is voided where the trip it belongs to falls away, where
the guest turns out never to have been eligible for the level, where the same trip was quoted twice, or where the
fee could not be taken at all, and the ground is recorded on the election.

Voiding is not the same as completing, and a voided election covers nothing for any part of the trip, so a loss
during a period later voided is not met.

Where the election is voided because the trip was cancelled, the fee is returned in full whatever the level's
ordinary refund terms, since the guest never had the vehicle.

Where it is voided because the guest was never eligible, the fee is returned but the guest is told that the trip
ran without cover, and any loss stands against them in full.

An election already voided is not voided again, and an election that has completed is corrected by reversal
rather than by voiding.

Only the marketplace voids an election; a guest who wants to end their cover changes level or cancels the trip
instead.

## The grounds and what each carries

| The ground recorded | What follows for the fee | What follows for a loss |
|---|---|---|
| The trip fell away | The fee is returned in full, whatever the level's ordinary refund terms | Nothing is covered for any part of the trip |
| The guest was never eligible for the level | The fee is returned | The trip ran without cover and any loss stands against the guest in full |
| The same trip was quoted twice | The duplicate quote is the election voided | Nothing is covered on the voided quote |
| The fee could not be taken at all | The ground is recorded on the election | Nothing is covered for any part of the trip |

Where more than one of these grounds is open on the same election, the duplicate quote ranks 1 among them and is
the ground recorded.

## The state the election must stand in

The election reference correlates the voiding to the election, and the state standing on that election record is
read before anything is voided. A quoted, elected or active election may be voided, and so may one already
voided, which is simply not voided a second time. An election that has completed is not voided at all: a
correction after that point is made against the lines that were wrong.

**A hypothetical duplicate.** Two quotes stand on one trip. The second is the duplicate; it is voided, and the
first continues to carry the cover. Neither guest statement nor the desk's own view of which quote is preferable
bears on it: a trip carries one live election.
